Team / Sara —

We have a 48-hour window to finalize Streetlight (ACME) before end-of-quarter cutoffs. Quick summary and asks: 

- Current commit: verbal approval for SOW + PO, legal redlines cleared. Finance needs signed PO or DocuSign by EOD Thu 12/8 to make this quarter.
- Probability in HubSpot currently 70% (HS-39285). Please update to 90% once PO is received.

Action items (owners / due):
1) Ben: final outreach cadence to buyer + confirm PO routing (Due: Wed 12/7 5pm PT).
2) Laura: pre-approve billing code + expedite PO intake (Due: Thu 12/8 12pm PT).
3) Monica: prepare invoice template and tag for Q4 recognition (Due: Thu 12/8 3pm PT).
4) David: approve one-time onboarding credit (if required) and confirm final close list (Due: Wed 12/7 EOD).

I've attached the Close-48h-Action-Grid.xlsx with a checklist and the draft ACME_SOW_Q4_PO_12-08.pdf for reference. Sara — if you can route the PO to Laura (laura_bennett@redwood.com) or use DocuSign link when ready, that will keep us on the quarter.

I will run a 10-minute standup at 9am PT Wednesday to surface blockers. If any dependency lands earlier, ping in the #q4-close channel.

Thanks,
Priyom Das
Director, Revenue Operations
Redwood Inference

Attachments: Close-48h-Action-Grid.xlsx (spreadsheet), ACME_SOW_Q4_PO_12-08.pdf (PDF)
